title: The Italian Center Bites
setup: White prepared d4 with c3 and pushed, and Black has just snatched a pawn in the center with a knight.
hint: One square attacks the loose knight and the point in Black's camp that only the king defends. Look for the overlap.
explanation:
## The Idea

This is what the c3 and d4 build-up is for: once the center opens, Black's pieces have nowhere safe to stand.

{{Qd5}} is a double attack. The queen hits the knight on e4, and down the other diagonal it hits f7, where the bishop on c4 already waits: {{Qxf7#}} would be mate. Black has to meet that first, and the knight drops.

No knight move saves it and holds f7 at once: on d6 it falls to the e5 pawn, on g5 to the knight on f3.
